entries.en:
The Hall of Rhetoric is frequented by many Amaurotines eager to engage in debate and discourse, and the one who approaches you is no exception. After mistaking you for a young child unfamiliar with rhetorical traditions, they task you with summoning a friend of theirs from outside the hall in order to give you a live demonstration─and perhaps one in which you may be permitted to participate.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

Vous avez été interpellé par un Amaurotain qui souhaitait débattre à l'improviste avec vous... Devant votre incompréhension manifeste, il vous a expliqué le fonctionnement du forum des Éloquents, grande halle où les citoyens viennent échanger leurs opinions sur des sujets divers et variés. Puis il vous a demandé d'aller chercher son ami, avec qui il a justement rendez-vous pour une joute verbale. Repérez l'Amaurotain disert, près du forum des Éloquents.

entries.en: The firebrand is not difficult to find, but they are disinclined to disengage from their current debate. If at first you do not succeed...
entries.fr: Vous avez retrouvé l'Amaurotain disert. Complètement absorbé par sa propre rhétorique, il vous a rabroué sèchement... Insistez.
entries.ja: 弁論好きのアーモロート市民と話したが、議論に熱中しているようだ。再度「弁論好きのアーモロート市民」に話しかけよう。
entries.frMacro: Vous avez retrouvé l'Amaurotain disert. Complètement absorbé par sa propre rhétorique, il vous a rabroué<if(gnum4,e,)> sèchement... Insistez.

entries.en: Another cursory attempt to catch the firebrand's attention ends in failure, leading you to wonder just how much longer you are expected to keep at this.
entries.fr: Cette fois, l'Amaurotain disert n'a même pas daigné vous répondre... Haussez le ton.
entries.ja: 弁論好きのアーモロート市民に話しかけたが、彼は話しかけられたことに気づいていないようだ。もう一度「弁論好きのアーモロート市民」に話しかけよう。

entries.en: The firebrand at last relents and decides to hear you out, at which point you explain your purpose in coming. Recalling that they owe their colleague a debate or two, they declare that now is as good an occasion as any and stride towards the hall.
entries.fr: La troisième fois a été la bonne ! L'Amaurotain disert s'en est allé rejoindre son ami l'Amaurotain amène au forum des Éloquents. Emboîtez-lui le pas.
entries.ja: 弁論好きのアーモロート市民と話し、彼はようやく議論をやめた。人民弁論館に戻り、「気さくなアーモロート市民」と話そう。

entries.en: The two Amaurotines engage in a spirited debate concerning whether or not their city should attempt to aid a distant metropolis across the sea which is said to be struggling with an unprecedented calamity of late. Though the two fail to come to a consensus, their discussion provides insight into the thought processes of the citizenry, as well as an opportunity for you to join in the discourse to a limited degree.
entries.fr: Les deux amis vous ont convié à leur curieux débat, où il était question de secourir ou non les habitants d'une cité ravagée par la catastrophe, mais sans aucune considération humanitaire... Après ce moment troublant, reparlez à l'Amaurotain amène.
entries.ja: 気さくなアーモロート市民と話し、弁論会に参加した。彼らはそれぞれ、独自の思想をもっているようだ。人民弁論館の「気さくなアーモロート市民」に、再度話しかけてみよう。

entries.en: The loquacious Amaurotine is a passionate believer in the free exchange of ideas, and they hope that your experiences in the Hall of Rhetoric will inspire you to participate in the public discourse when you are older. Indeed, they sense that you may have the potential to change Amaurot in ways no one might think possible, and they state that they will be watching your trajectory with great interest...
entries.fr: D'après l'Amaurotain amène, la finalité d'un débat est de s'enrichir mutuellement sur le plan intellectuel, et non de décider de qui a raison. Mais ça, vous le saviez déjà...
entries.ja: 気さくなアーモロート市民と話した。彼らにとって弁論とは、なによりも高尚なものらしい。

entries.en: The Hall of Rhetoric is, as its name indicates, a place where citizens may freely gather to discuss and debate all manner of topics. This central forum is ideal for open discourse, but smaller rooms are available for those desiring more intimate conversation. Oh, and there is a wealth of reading material concerning rhetorical techniques and history penned by the greatest minds on offer as well, should you wish to refine your techniques through self-study.

entries.fr: Le forum des Éloquents, c'est le lieu de rendez-vous de tous ceux qui veulent échanger leurs opinions, sur n'importe quel sujet. Tu peux t'exprimer en public, louer une salle privée, ou encore consulter les transcriptions de grands débats qui ont marqué l'Histoire.

ここ人民弁論館は、自由に弁論を行うための施設だよ。
ホールで立ち話的に議論を行うもよし、部屋を借りるもよし、
過去の優秀な弁論を収めた文書を検索するのもよし、だ。

entries.en: No no no, my position has nothing to do with the intrinsic value of unique identity and whether or not it is retained! Rather, I posit that the reproductions of a given concept are inherently imperfect, and thus they are themselves unique, albeit in minor but significant degrees, and─most importantly─this variance is not to be condemned, but celebrated! Better that than to strive in vain for an impossible standard that, even if met, would leave us lesser for lack of diversity!

entries.en: So you're to be an observer? No no, that will not do. You must be an active participant─you must engage in the discourse. Only by doing will you learn and grow, little one!

entries.fr: Encore toi ? Ne me dis pas que tu veux participer à notre débat. Encore que ça pourrait être intéressant... Après tout, ne dit-on pas que la vérité sort de la bouche des enfants ?
entries.ja:
なんだい、君も議論に参加するのかい？
若い者の弁論も刺激になるだろうから、大歓迎だよ。

entries.en: I see you found my friend! Thank you, little one. Then without further ado, let us commence the promised debate!
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>I see you found my friend! Thank you, little one. Then without further ado, let us commence the promised debate!<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Merci de m'avoir ramené mon ami retardataire. Notre échange d'idées va pouvoir débuter. Surtout, n'hésite pas à réagir à nos propos.
entries.ja:
やあやあ、知人を連れてきてくれて、ありがとう。
では約束のとおり、君を交えて弁論会としゃれこもうじゃないか。

では約束のとおり、君を交えて弁論会としゃれこもうじゃないか。

entries.en: As to the matter of what subject we shall debate today, I propose the recent calamity which has befallen our friends across the pond. What say you?
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>As to the matter of what subject we shall debate today, I propose the recent calamity which has befallen our friends across the pond. What say you?<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Avant tout, mettons-nous d'accord sur le thème du débat. Personnellement, j'aimerais aborder le sujet brûlant du moment : la cité d'outre-mer, qui à l'heure où je te parle est sur le point d'être rayée de la carte.
entries.ja:
では、まず今回の議題を提起しよう。
昨今みなの関心が高いのは、海向こうの都が、
いよいよ「災厄」により、滅びようとしていることではないかな？
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>Avant tout, mettons-nous d'accord sur le thème du débat. Per<->son<->nel<->le<->ment, j'aimerais aborder le sujet brûlant du moment<nbsp>: la cité d'outre-mer, qui à l'heure où je te parle est sur le point d'être rayée de la carte.<colortype(0)>

では、まず今回の議題を提起しよう。
昨今みなの関心が高いのは、海向こうの都が、
いよいよ「災厄」により、滅びようとしていることではないかな？
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: The singular point of contention is, of course, whether or not Amaurot should intervene on their behalf.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>The singular point of contention is, of course, whether or not Amaurot should intervene on their behalf.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: La question est : devons-nous porter secours à ses habitants ?
entries.ja: そこでだ、我々は彼らを救うべきだろうか。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>La question est<nbsp>: devons-nous porter secours à ses habitants<nbsp>?<colortype(0)>
entries.jaMacro: <colortype(547)>そこでだ、我々は彼らを救うべきだろうか。<colortype(0)>
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: I believe we should. The scale of the disaster which threatens that distant metropolis is of a scale heretofore unseen, and so equally considerable resources must be committed to counteracting its effects.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>I believe we should. The scale of the disaster which threatens that distant metropolis is of a scale heretofore unseen, and so equally considerable resources must be committed to counteracting its effects.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Moi je pense que oui, ne serait-ce que parce que la catastrophe qui s'est produite là-bas est tout à fait inédite de par sa nature.
entries.ja:
僕は救うべきだと思う。
件の災厄は、かつてない現象だと聞くからね。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>Moi je pense que oui, ne serait-ce que parce que la catastrophe qui s'est produite là-bas est tout à fait inédite de par sa nature.<colortype(0)>
entries.jaMacro:
僕は救うべきだと思う。
件の災厄は、かつてない現象だと聞くからね。
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: I disagree. The scale concerns me less than the nature of the proposition itself. Who are we to unilaterally intervene in the affairs of those half a world away? Are we to be the saviors of one and all? Such arrogance may well lead to our own downfall.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>I disagree. The scale concerns me less than the nature of the proposition itself. Who are we to unilaterally intervene in the affairs of those half a world away? Are we to be the saviors of one and all? Such arrogance may well lead to our own downfall.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: ... Je ne suis pas d'accord. Ce serait prétentieux de vouloir les sauver.
entries.ja:
いいや、私は救うべきではないと思うね。
そもそも「救う」という発想が、傲慢の表れさ。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>... Je ne suis pas d'accord. Ce serait prétentieux de vouloir les sauver.<colortype(0)>
entries.jaMacro:
いいや、私は救うべきではないと思うね。
そもそも「救う」という発想が、傲慢の表れさ。
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLEE03593

entries.en: Hm. While I understand your concerns from a philosophical standpoint, I fear you are too quick to dismiss practical considerations out of a desire to maintain an unassailable moral authority.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>Hm. While I understand your concerns from a philosophical standpoint, I fear you are too quick to dismiss practical considerations out of a desire to maintain an unassailable moral authority.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Hmm... Je ne vois pas ce qui te fait dire ça...
entries.ja:
ううむ…………。
そのような結論に至る思考の経路が存在するとは、
にわかには信じがたいな。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>Hmm... Je ne vois pas ce qui te fait dire ça...<colortype(0)>
entries.jaMacro:
ううむ…………。
そのような結論に至る思考の経路が存在するとは、
にわかには信じがたいな。
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: But let us you and I hold here for the present and offer the floor to our young student. You have heard our opening salvos in this debate concerning the fate of our neighbors across the sea. What is your opinion on the matter?
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>But let us you and I hold here for the present and offer the floor to our young student. You have heard our opening salvos in this debate concerning the fate of our neighbors across the sea. What is your opinion on the matter?<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Demandons à notre jeune invité ce qu' en pense... D'après toi, on sauve la cité sinistrée ou on la laisse disparaître ?
entries.ja:
じゃあ小さな弁論家よ、君はどう考える？
未曾有の災厄により、滅びつつある海向こうの都を、
救うべきか、救うべきではないか？
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>Demandons à notre jeune invité<if(gnum4,e,)> ce qu'<if(gnum4,elle,il)> en pense... D'après toi, on sauve la cité sinistrée ou on la laisse disparaître<nbsp>?<colortype(0)>

じゃあ小さな弁論家よ、君はどう考える？
未曾有の災厄により、滅びつつある海向こうの都を、
救うべきか、救うべきではないか？
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: What will you say?
entries.fr: Que répondez-vous ?
entries.ja: 何と答える？
entries.frMacro: Que répondez-vous<nbsp>?

entries.en: To ignore the plight of those one might conceivably save is not wisdom─it is indolence.
entries.fr: On la sauve, bien sûr !
entries.ja: 救うべき
entries.frMacro: On la sauve, bien sûr<nbsp>!

entries.en: We cannot save everyone. Sometimes, it is all we can do to save ourselves.
entries.fr: On la laisse disparaître.
entries.ja: 救うべきではない

entries.en: Indeed, indeed. The same can be said regardless of one's opinion on the morality of intervention. There is a clear and undeniable benefit to Amaurot in using this situation as a test bed for our newest creations, that we might develop and refine our defenses against a potential threat to our own fair city.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>Indeed, indeed. The same can be said regardless of one's opinion on the morality of intervention. There is a clear and undeniable benefit to Amaurot in using this situation as a test bed for our newest creations, that we might develop and refine our defenses against a potential threat to our own fair city.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: N'est-ce pas ? Un désastre d'une telle ampleur, c'est l'occasion rêvée de mettre à profit notre magie créatrice. Il n'y a rien de plus gratifiant que de déjouer le destin de ses propres mains.
entries.ja:
うんうん、そうだろうとも。
このような機会、我らの創造魔法を試すには絶好だ。
未知の困難を、己の力量で覆していく快感たるや！
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>N'est-ce pas<nbsp>? Un désastre d'une telle ampleur, c'est l'occasion rêvée de mettre à profit notre magie créatrice. Il n'y a rien de plus gratifiant que de déjouer le destin de ses propres mains.<colortype(0)>
entries.jaMacro:
うんうん、そうだろうとも。
このような機会、我らの創造魔法を試すには絶好だ。
未知の困難を、己の力量で覆していく快感たるや！
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: How readily you cede the moral high ground! Was not our young friend's point that we have an ethical obligation to aid those in need? Yet not only do you instead elect to focus on the benefit to Amaurot alone, but you also deprive our distant neighbors of the agency to determine their own fate!
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>How readily you cede the moral high ground! Was not our young friend's point that we have an ethical obligation to aid those in need? Yet not only do you instead elect to focus on the benefit to Amaurot alone, but you also deprive our distant neighbors of the agency to determine their own fate!<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Et que faites-vous des populations locales ? Vous leur ôteriez le privilège d'affronter eux-mêmes l'adversité ? Nous sommes assez sages, il me semble, pour ne pas commettre cet impair.
entries.ja:
いやいや、我らが手を出してしまったら、
海向こうの人々から、その喜びを奪うことになるではないか！
そのような無礼、知識人としてあるまじき行為であるぞ。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>Et que faites-vous des populations locales<nbsp>? Vous leur ôteriez le privilège d'affronter eux-mêmes l'adversité<nbsp>? Nous sommes assez sages, il me semble, pour ne pas commettre cet impair.<colortype(0)>

いやいや、我らが手を出してしまったら、

そのような無礼、知識人としてあるまじき行為であるぞ。
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLEE03593

entries.en: You misunderstand me. What benefits Amaurot benefits all creation, I firmly believe, for the knowledge and wisdom we stand to gain from intervention can then be shared with others, empowering everyone to more effectively surmount similar trials in the future...
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>You misunderstand me. What benefits Amaurot benefits all creation, I firmly believe, for the knowledge and wisdom we stand to gain from intervention can then be shared with others, empowering everyone to more effectively surmount similar trials in the future...<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: ... Ton raisonnement se tient. Mais l'on ne m'enlèvera pas que c'est un véritable gâchis d'ignorer un phénomène aussi spectaculaire, surtout pour nous qui avons à peu près tout vu en matière de catastrophes naturelles...
entries.ja:
ふーむ、それも一理あるな。
いや、しかし、我々にとって未知の現象が減ってしまった今、
みすみす見逃すというのも…………。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>... Ton raisonnement se tient. Mais l'on ne m'enlèvera pas que c'est un véritable gâchis d'ignorer un phénomène aussi spectaculaire, surtout pour nous qui avons à peu près tout vu en matière de catastrophes naturelles...<colortype(0)>

いや、しかし、我々にとって未知の現象が減ってしまった今、
みすみす見逃すというのも…………。
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings, the unvarnished truth and purest wisdom! One must first look to one's own welfare before that of others, and the same must be said of our distant neighbors. To save them would be to deprive them of the agency to determine their own fate!
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings, the unvarnished truth and purest wisdom! One must first look to one's own welfare before that of others, and the same must be said of our distant neighbors. To save them would be to deprive them of the agency to determine their own fate!<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Ah, voilà  qui a de la jugeote. Tu as compris qu'il convenait de laisser aux populations locales une chance de s'en sortir seules. Qu'intervenir contre leur gré reviendrait à leur faire offense.
entries.ja:
うむ、よくわかっているな、お若いの。
せっかく未知の困難が迫っているのだから、我らが手出しをして、
解決する喜びを横取りしては、失礼というものよな。

せっかく未知の困難が迫っているのだから、我らが手出しをして、

entries.en: If self-interest is to take precedence, then consider the lost benefit to Amaurot. There is clear and undeniable value in using this situation as a test bed for our newest creations, that we might develop and refine our defenses against a potential threat to our own fair city.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>If self-interest is to take precedence, then consider the lost benefit to Amaurot. There is clear and undeniable value in using this situation as a test bed for our newest creations, that we might develop and refine our defenses against a potential threat to our own fair city.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Et notre chance à nous, tu y as pensé ? Au gâchis que ce serait de ne pas la saisir ? Non, franchement, si les locaux tiennent tant que ça à affronter l'adversité, ils n'ont qu'à proposer leur aide aux futures cités sinistrées.
entries.ja:
だからといって、せっかくの危機を見過ごすなんてもったいない。
ほかの都市の者と共闘して、困難に立ち向かっていくという、
あらたな喜びもあるかもしれないんだぞ。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>Et notre chance à nous, tu y as pensé<nbsp>? Au gâchis que ce serait de ne pas la saisir<nbsp>? Non, franchement, si les locaux tiennent tant que ça à affronter l'adversité, ils n'ont qu'à proposer leur aide aux futures cités sinistrées.<colortype(0)>

entries.en: A plea to practicality, I see─and one which you doubtless believe I have given you ample cause to invoke. But you misrepresent my arguments as enlightened self-interest, when in truth it is a rather more nuanced position...
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>A plea to practicality, I see─and one which you doubtless believe I have given you ample cause to invoke. But you misrepresent my arguments as enlightened self-interest, when in truth it is a rather more nuanced position...<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Tu peux dire ce que tu veux... Pour moi, la bienséance passe avant notre envie de nous divertir.
entries.ja:
むむ、確かにそれは魅力的だが……。
しかし、我々には礼儀というものがだな…………。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>Tu peux dire ce que tu veux... Pour moi, la bienséance passe avant notre envie de nous divertir.<colortype(0)>

しかし、我々には礼儀というものがだな…………。

entries.en: I must say, it has been far too long since I engaged in such a refreshing exchange of ideas! My colleague was equally delighted by the opportunity, you may be assured.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>I must say, it has been far too long since I engaged in such a refreshing exchange of ideas! My colleague was equally delighted by the opportunity, you may be assured.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: C'était un débat plutôt constructif, et ce n'est pas mon camarade qui me contredira.
entries.ja:
いやあ、今回も有意義な議論だったね。
知人も満足して帰っていったよ。
entries.frMacro: <colortype(547)>C'était un débat plutôt constructif, et ce n'est pas mon camarade qui me contredira.<colortype(0)>
entries.jaMacro:
いやあ、今回も有意義な議論だったね。
知人も満足して帰っていったよ。
entries.speaker: AMAUROTPEOPLED03593

entries.en: Some decry it as little more than an academic exercise─after all, we failed to reach a meaningful consensus─but I daresay they miss the forest for the trees. Are we not more enlightened by the experience? Have we not been exposed to a greater variety of viewpoints? Is there not value in this alone?
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>Some decry it as little more than an academic exercise─after all, we failed to reach a meaningful consensus─but I daresay they miss the forest for the trees. Are we not more enlightened by the experience? Have we not been exposed to a greater variety of viewpoints? Is there not value in this alone?<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Évidemment, la question reste entière, mais ce n'est pas un problème. Si nous confrontons nos points de vue, ce n'est pas tant pour savoir qui a raison que pour nous donner matière à réflexion.
entries.ja:
まあ、結論はでていないけど、
議論の目的は、自分の考えの幅を広げることだからね。
結論を出す出さないは、二の次でいいのさ。

entries.en: I truly believe we are blessed to be part of a society that exalts the free exchange of ideas, and that encourages active participation in the public discourse.
entries.macro: <colortype(547)>I truly believe we are blessed to be part of a society that exalts the free exchange of ideas, and that encourages active participation in the public discourse.<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Nous autres Amaurotains considérons le débat comme un moyen noble d'aiguiser notre esprit critique, et d'échanger des informations diverses et variées.
entries.ja:
アーモロート市民にとって、
弁論は情報伝達と自己研鑽を兼ね備えた、
なによりも高尚な、知のやり取りだからね。

entries.en: This may have been no more than your first foray into the exciting world of rhetoric, but I sense you have the soul of a debater in you. You may well have the potential to change Amaurot in ways no one ever thought possible. I shall be watching your trajectory with great interest, my young friend!

You may well have the potential to change Amaurot in ways no one ever thought possible. I shall be watching your trajectory with great interest, my young friend!<colortype(0)>
entries.fr: Tout cela doit te sembler un brin compliqué... Ne t'en fais pas, petit à petit, tu apprendras à exprimer tes opinions de façon précise et convaincante. C'est tout le mal que je te souhaite, en tout cas.
entries.ja:
君が楽しんでくれたなら、よかったのだが……。
ともかく、今日の見学はここまでとしよう。
それでは、またね。
